fullPassage: Since hydra and the immortal jellyfish don't exhibit obvious signs of aging, they are often called biologically immortal. This doesn't mean they don't die. Nor does it even ① mean that they cannot die of biological causes. But, unlike most every animal, their likelihood of dying does not increase with age. But their property of being able to regenerate entire body parts, or even a whole organism, ② making them more similar to trees than to us. Although we may learn some fascinating things about their lack of apparent aging, it is not at all clear how ③ relevant those findings will be to human aging. But in other cases, even discoveries in rats or mice, ④ which are mammals and biologically much closer to us, are difficult to translate into humans. It may be a very long time before any findings gained from hydra or jellyfish ⑤ are useful to us.

Species such as hydra and the immortal jellyfish excite gerontologists because they may provide clues about how to defeat the aging process. But their property of being able to regenerate entire body parts, or even a whole organism,  making them more similar to trees than to us. Although we may learn some fascinating things about their lack of apparent aging, it is not at all clear how  relevant those findings will be to human aging. Sometimes biology is universal, especially if it relates to fundamental mechanisms. But in other cases, even discoveries in rats or mice,  which are mammals and biologically much closer to us, are __________ into humans. It may be a very long time before any findings gained from hydra or jellyfish  are useful to us.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 쥐나 생쥐의 발견조차 인간에게 적용하기 어렵다(difficult to translate).
det.analysis:
✅ ① difficult to translate: 원문 일치 (even discoveries ... are difficult to translate into humans) ←정답

❌ ② easy to adopt(채택하기 쉬운): 반대 의미

❌ ③ simple to apply(적용하기 간단한): 반대 의미

❌ ④ ready to use(사용 준비된): 문맥 부적절
det.tip: difficult to translate into humans = 인간에게 적용(이식)하기 어려운

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 하이드라와 해파리는 노화 과정을 물리치는(defeat the aging process) 방법에 대한 단서를 줄 수 있어 노인학자들을 흥분시킨다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① speed up their growth(성장을 가속하다): 문맥 부적절

❌ ② copy human genes(인간 유전자를 복제하다): 본문 근거 없음

✅ ③ defeat the aging process: 원문 일치 (clues about how to defeat the aging process) ←정답

❌ ④ avoid every disease(모든 질병을 피하다): 본문 근거 없음
det.tip: defeat the aging process = 노화 과정을 물리치다
